pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Xberg;

try
{
var result = XbergConverter.PdfPageCount(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("this is not a pdf document"), null);
}
catch (Exception error)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"{error.GetType().Name}: {error.Message}");
}
```
